svg.title: Infertility decision chart: when to investigate, then one column per factor the work-up tests (ovulation, ovarian reserve, tubes and cavity, endometriosis, male factor) plus recurrent pregnancy loss; each gives the test and its cycle day, what an abnormal result means, the causes and the treatment it leads to

svg.text: Infertility: no pregnancy after 1 YEAR of regular, unprotected intercourse · investigate BOTH partners

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: work up at 12 MONTHS if under 35 · at 6 MONTHS if 35 or over · IMMEDIATELY if a known cause (e.g. irregular cycles)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: female alone 41% · male alone 24% · both 24% · unexplained 11% · 85% conceive by 1 year

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: FEMALE: tests timed to her cycle (day 1 = first day of bleeding)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: days 2–4 bloods · days 6–12 sonohysterogram · day 21 progesterone · AMH any day

svg.text: • anovulation (PCOS) → weight loss, then LETROZOLE or clomiphene ± trigger

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • endometriosis I–II → laparoscopic excision · III–IV → IVF

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • low reserve → IVF at higher doses · age is not rescued by IVF

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • BOTH partners need an infectious disease screen before IUI or IVF (law in Ontario)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • sperm should be WAITING: best ~2 days BEFORE ovulation · ovulation ~36 h after the LH surge

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • myths: a D&C does not help · a retroverted uterus does not cause infertility · 2+ weeks of abstinence does
